Forecast Discussion

NWS Detroit/Pontiac · 743 PM EDT Tue Oct 27 2026

- Dry today with cooler temperatures compared to recent days. 

- Mild temperatures return through the rest of the week highlighted
  by highs around 70 Wednesday and in the lower to mid 70s Thursday.

- There is a chance of showers Thursday afternoon and Thursday night.

- Dry and continued mild Friday.

&&

.AVIATION...

Combination of ESE flow off of Lake Erie/St. Clair under a mid-high 
cloud deck leads to a tricky fog forecast for tonight. Surface 
dewpoints still around 50 degrees are expected to be reinforced 
throughout the night by lake moisture, which in combination with 
nearly calm surface winds should be able to offset the less 
efficient cooling potential due to cloud cover. Thus the inherited 
MVFR restrictions for BR Wednesday morning are reasonable, mainly 
for the Detroit vicinity terminals. Otherwise, light ESE winds will 
veer to the SW Wednesday while an upper level wave passes through in 
the morning. This eventually scours out moisture for the afternoon 
leading to clearing skies and another day of quiet weather across 
the airspace. 

D21/DTW Convection... Thunderstorms are not forecast through the TAF 
period.

.DTW THRESHOLD PROBABILITIES...

 * Low for cigs at or below 5000 ft through tonight.
